Description:
As a new visitor, I want to create a secure personal account with unique credentials, so that I can access personalized book reviews and shelves.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Required registration fields are validated
- Passwords are securely hashed with bcrypt (work factor=12)
- Duplicate username/email is rejected
- Invalid input is rejected
- Successful registration creates a USER account
- User cannot self-register as ADMIN

As a registered user, I want to authenticate with my username/email and password, so that I can securely access my private session.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Valid credentials authenticate successfully
- Invalid credentials are rejected without user enumeration
- Passwords are never stored or displayed in plaintext
- Secure server-side session is created with HttpOnly/SameSite
- Authentication failures do not expose sensitive information

As an authenticated user, I want to terminate my session on logout, so that my account cannot be accessed from a shared or public device.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Logout invalidates the session completely
- Protected pages cannot be accessed after logout
- Session handling follows secure configuration

As a reader, I want to search and filter books by keyword, author, and genre, so that I can discover books matching my interests.

Acceptance Criteria:
- User can search by title
- User can search by author
- User can search by genre
- Search input is validated
- Database queries are safely parameterized/ORM based

As a reader, I want to view full metadata, synopsis, and community reviews for a book, so that I can evaluate whether to read it.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Book details are displayed
- Ratings are displayed
- Reviews are displayed
- Average rating is calculated correctly
- Nonexistent books return safe handling

As an authenticated reader, I want to assign a 1-5 star rating and post a written review, so that I can contribute to the community catalog.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Rating is restricted to 1-5
- User can submit a review
- Review input is validated (5-2000 chars)
- Review belongs to correct user and book
- Invalid/malicious input is rejected safely

As a review author, I want to update or delete my existing review, so that I can manage my published opinions.

Acceptance Criteria:
- User can edit their own review
- User can delete their own review
- User cannot edit another user's review
- User cannot delete another user's review
- Unauthorized attempts do not modify the database

As a reader, I want to maintain a private reading shelf (want-to-read, reading, finished), so that I can track my personal reading journey.

Acceptance Criteria:
- User can add a book
- User can update reading status
- User can remove a book
- Reading list is associated with the authenticated user
- Other users cannot modify the list

As an administrator, I want to create, update, and delete books in the catalog, so that the platform inventory stays accurate and up-to-date.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Admin can create books
- Admin can edit books
- Admin can delete books
- Normal users cannot perform admin book operations
- Unauthorized access is denied with 403 Forbidden

As an administrator, I want to hide or restore abusive reviews with a mandatory reason, so that community safety and decency standards are maintained.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Admin can view reviews requiring moderation
- Admin can remove/hide inappropriate reviews
- Moderation action is recorded with mandatory reason
- Normal users cannot perform moderation

As a security engineer, I want object-level authorization enforced on all mutable resources, so that horizontal privilege escalation (IDOR) attacks are completely blocked.

Acceptance Criteria:
- User A can modify only their own resources
- User B cannot modify User A's resources
- Unauthorized requests return appropriate denial
- Database remains unchanged after unauthorized attempts
- Authorization is enforced server-side

As a security auditor, I want a tamper-evident audit log of all security and administrative events, so that system activities are traceable and non-repudiable.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Security-sensitive actions are logged
- Admin actions are logged
- Authorization failures are logged where appropriate
- Logs do not contain passwords/secrets

As a QA/Security tester, I want automated test suites covering unit, integration, authorization, and fuzzing vectors, so that vulnerabilities are detected before release.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Authentication tests exist
- Authorization tests exist
- IDOR tests exist
- Validation/security tests exist
- Automated tests produce real results
- Security scans are executed when the tools are available

As a DevSecOps engineer, I want a GitHub Actions pipeline running tests and SAST scans on every push, so that code quality and security policies are automatically enforced.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Pipeline installs dependencies
- Pipeline runs tests
- Pipeline runs available security checks
- Pipeline reports failures
- Pipeline uses minimal permissions where applicable

As a DevOps engineer, I want the platform containerized with non-root security and equipped with Kubernetes manifests, so that the application is production-deployable.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Dockerfile exists and builds cleanly
- Image can be built where Docker is available
- Application does not run as root (UID 10001:10001)
- Secrets are not baked into image
- Health check exists (/health returns healthy)
- Kubernetes manifests exist with resource limits/probes
